name: ARA4103
title: Text uses a fallback font
summary: Shaping fell back to a secondary font for some text (information).
html:
Shaping fell back to a secondary font for some text (information).

#Common causes

  • The primary font lacks the script.

#Fixes

  • Keep the required fallback pack, or choose a primary font covering the script.

  • Code: ARA4103

  • Constant: ui::FALLBACK_FONT

  • Reported by: ara-ui-test
